claims.text: Claridge's is in the heart of Mayfair, London.

findings.quote: Claridge’s, in the heart of Mayfair, is shaped by centuries of enduring artistry
Since its founding in 1812, Claridge’s has stood as a beacon of elegance in the heart of Mayfair.

claims.text: Mayfair is a quiet neighbourhood of Georgian townhouses, refined restaurants and Savile Row shops.

findings.quote: Quiet Mayfair scores nil points for cool and trendy, but those wanting a chocolate-box vision of London full of elegant Georgian townhouses, refined restaurants, and Savile Row shops can get their full fix here.

claims.text: The suites feature balconies overlooking Brook Street.

findings.quote: The suites feature balconies overlooking Brook Street.

findings.quote: In the 210-square-meter Georgian suite
